# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native mobile portrait game titled **Four Winds Avatar Quest**. Preserve the source mechanics: top-down joystick movement in a large world, speed-based bridge/gate launches, three airborne action buttons, combo scoring on clean landing, hazard bounce/fumble feedback, manual end modal, and restart. Reinterpret the experience as Avatar The Last Airbender elemental quest RPG with martial-arts bending, found-family warmth, spiritual balance, redemption arcs, world travel, mythic heroic growth, and mobile-first portrait controls. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art: a young robed Avatar focal actor with glowing arrow and elemental trails, spirit bridges, corruption thorn hazards, sky-bison companion motifs, temple-grid backgrounds, compact readable HUD, and touch-friendly controls for 4:7 to 9:16 portrait screens.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: mobile-first top-down free-roam trick traversal arcade RPG-lite
- objective: build speed, cross bridge/gate triggers, perform one of three airborne actions, and land after the action timer completes to bank score
- input model: left-side virtual joystick / pointer drag for movement; three right-side action buttons available only while airborne; end/restart CTA buttons
- core loop: steer on ground, hit a gate at speed to launch, tap a trick/bending action, wait out the airborne action before landing, earn points, continue exploring
- fail/friction state: hitting hazards bounces the avatar into the air with crash feedback; landing before an action resolves fumbles the combo; manual end opens the results modal

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve world size, joystick acceleration/friction, speed threshold for gates, airborne gravity, three action buttons, combo scoring of 100 per completed action, hazard bounce, manual end state, and restart reset.
- Preserve mobile pointer/touch semantics and keep UI buttons on native tap/click paths.
- Preserve scoring and failure semantics; the remix reframes score as Balance/Harmony without changing numeric rules.

## Remix Direction
The rebuilt game becomes Four Winds Avatar Quest: a young elemental Avatar travels temple paths with a found family, rides spirit bridges, performs fire/water/earth bending forms while airborne, and restores spiritual balance through calm landings. Presentation, HUD copy, focal silhouette, procedural background, particles, and audio tone are transformed while mechanics remain faithful.
